questions.text: Does the plan include specific actions for mitigation of greenhouse gas emissions, including technological solutions and behaviour change?
questions.answer: The local government's Environment Strategy 2018-2022 does include specific actions for the mitigation of greenhouse gas emissions. The policy outlines a range of technological solutions and behaviour changes aimed at reducing emissions. Technological solutions include the implementation of the Watts Working Better Street Lighting Project, the introduction of a garden organics service, increased recycling to reduce waste to landfill, and the installation of solar power at the Echuca Library. Behaviour changes are encouraged through the support of community-based energy efficiency and renewable energy projects. The policy also mentions the investigation of a council-led solar bulk buy program to assist households in investing in solar energy.
